user.title: Technicolor Homeware router
user.description: Enter the router address and the web interface login. On Telekom routers the user is admin and the password is the Access Key printed on the label under the device.

reauth_confirm.title: Router password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the stored password. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the router web interface.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong username or password (after several failed attempts the router may lock the login for a while).
error.unsupported: Logged in, but the device list page was not found on this firmware.
